title: Rudolf Blaschka 1892 sketchbook digital-surrogate integrity and full-pass audit
scope: Backend-only inspection of all 30 pages in Rakow_1000043361_BlaschkaSketchbook.pdf. Blank leaves are classified but not treated as evidence. The audit distinguishes substantive marks, show-through, covers, and digital duplication.
frontend_policy: No sketchbook image, thumbnail, image-derived layer, or inferred geometry is to be added to public Pages in this phase.

source.repository: Rakow Research Library, The Corning Museum of Glass
source.embedded_image_character: one 300-ppi JPEG image per PDF page
source.catalogue_note: Most physical pages are blank and were not filmed; a few laid-in island/palm sketches were filmed. Catalogue also says the beginning sketch is captioned Tempe, Arizona, 22 April 1892.

full_pass.note: Caption securely reads 'Wüste bei Maricopa (Arizona) / 24. April 1892'; landscape visible faintly through paper.
Maricopa desert panorama associated with page-4 caption.
High-probability reading: 'Cactus-Wüste bei Maricopa (Arizona) / 24. April 1892'; botanical annotation probably 'Opuntia bigelovii'.
Dense cactus desert and mountain mass associated with page-8 caption.
Abrupt rocky massif over sparse desert; no inscription; candidate Arizona-Yuma-Salton-San Jacinto rail-corridor view.

Rendered RGB pixels are exactly identical to page 12. PDF image objects are separate object IDs but carry identical visual content. This is a digital-surrogate duplication, not a second independent drawing.
Compatible with show-through from the following Yucca landscape; no independent inscription identified.
Joshua-tree/Yucca desert. Visible graphite at right is probably 'Yucca brevifolia'; no secure place/date inscription. Hesperia identification rests on correspondence/ecology synchronization.
Harbour/lagoon, palms, buildings and mountain background; probable Jamaica group.
Banded lighthouse, harbour water, palm-covered island/shore and mountains. Strong probable Port Antonio configuration: Folly Point Lighthouse + Navy Island.
Palm-lined water/shore; likely same material group as pages 21 and 23, but no diagnostic landmark.

Includes 'Chr. Baldewein & Sohn / am Wall', 'Schüsselkorb 14', a probable Brinkmann/address line, 'am Markt', and arithmetic. First two place the note securely in Bremen address space; exact journey function undated.

Secure reading: 'Von New York bis Bremen sind 880 geographische Meilen'. At 7.42044 km per German geographical mile, the noted value is about 6,530 km; likely rounded route/travel calculation rather than geodesic measurement.

Secure numerical core: '27 1/2 Centimeter' and '11 Engl. Inches'. 27.5 cm equals about 10.83 inches, showing practical metric-English conversion. The heading appears to refer to a length/cylinder but is not yet diplomatically secure; object measured is unknown.

digital_integrity_findings.duplicate_test: Page-12 and page-13 renders have identical dimensions and zero mean absolute RGB pixel difference.
digital_integrity_findings.interpretive_consequence: The 30-page PDF is not a transparently one-to-one sequence of unique physical leaves. At least one exact duplicated scan exists. Therefore the catalogue-surrogate Tempe conflict must remain unresolved; missing/duplicated/reassembled delivery content is a live explanation alongside catalogue metadata error.
digital_integrity_findings.page_number_guard: Digital PDF page number is a surrogate frame identifier, not a physical folio number. Do not infer physical adjacency, recto/verso order, or chronology from PDF sequence alone without additional controls.

functional_reassessment.revised_description: travel working sketchbook/notebook combining landscape observation, botanical annotation, address/logistics notes, transatlantic distance calculation, and metric-English measurement conversion
functional_reassessment.knowledge_production_implication: The object participated in travel operations as well as representation. It stored environmental views, plant names, practical addresses, distances and measurements in the same portable medium.

external_control_targets.purpose: verify Baldewein, Schüsselkorb 14, probable Brinkmann line, and determine whether page 26 records suppliers/hotels/logistics
compare frame list with PDF assembly; determine whether the duplicated page 12/13 reflects source delivery and whether a Tempe 22 April frame exists outside the PDF

next_actions: Search the 1892 Bremen resident/street/business directories for every legible page-26 name/address; do not create itinerary points until function/date is known.
If accessible, compare the Primo 30-JPG list against this PDF frame-by-frame; prioritize resolving the catalogue claim for Tempe 22 April and the page-12/13 duplicate.
Treat page 28 as measurement-practice evidence and seek a correspondence/object context before identifying the measured item.
Keep all sketchbook-derived imagery and geospatial hypotheses backend-only.
